package handlers

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

func (h ModuleHandler) mapModuleListResponse(r *http.Request, items []domain.Module, fields queryfields.Set) ([]map[string]any, error) {
	if items == nil {
		items = []domain.Module{}
	}
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	includeI18n := fields.Has("title") || fields.Has("description") || fields.Has("translations")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	for _, item := range items {
		var translations []domain.ModuleI18n
		if includeI18n && h.GetUC.ModuleI18n != nil {
			var err error
			translations, err = h.GetUC.ModuleI18n.ListByModule(r.Context(), item.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		result = append(result, buildModuleFields(item, translations, fields, lang))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (h SectionHandler) mapSectionListResponse(r *http.Request, items []domain.Section, fields queryfields.Set) ([]map[string]any, error) {
	if items == nil {
		items = []domain.Section{}
	}
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	includeI18n := fields.Has("title") || fields.Has("description") || fields.Has("translations")
	lang := resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"))
	for _, item := range items {
		var translations []domain.SectionI18n
		if includeI18n && h.GetUC.SectionI18n != nil {
			var err error
			translations, err = h.GetUC.SectionI18n.ListBySection(r.Context(), item.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		result = append(result, buildSectionFields(item, translations, fields, lang))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func buildModuleFields(item domain.Module, translations []domain.ModuleI18n, fields queryfields.Set, lang string) map[string]any {
	out := map[string]any{}
	if fields.Has("id") {
		out["id"] = item.ID
	}
	if fields.Has("tech_id") {
		out["tech_id"] = item.TechID
	}
	if fields.Has("status") {
		out["status"] = item.Status
	}
	if fields.Has("visibility") {
		out["visibility"] = item.Visibility
	}
	if fields.Has("lesson_read_access") {
		out["lesson_read_access"] = item.LessonReadAccess
	}
	if fields.Has("created_at") {
		out["created_at"] = item.CreatedAt
	}
	if fields.Has("updated_at") {
		out["updated_at"] = item.UpdatedAt
	}
	translation := selectModuleTranslation(translations, lang)
	if fields.Has("title") {
		out["title"] = translation.Title
	}
	if fields.Has("description") {
		out["description"] = translation.Description
	}
	if fields.Has("translations") {
		out["translations"] = mapModuleTranslationResponse(translations)
	}
	return out
}

func buildSectionFields(item domain.Section, translations []domain.SectionI18n, fields queryfields.Set, lang string) map[string]any {
	out := map[string]any{}
	if fields.Has("id") {
		out["id"] = item.ID
	}
	if fields.Has("tech_id") {
		out["tech_id"] = item.TechID
	}
	if fields.Has("status") {
		out["status"] = item.Status
	}
	if fields.Has("lesson_read_access") {
		out["lesson_read_access"] = item.LessonReadAccess
	}
	if fields.Has("created_at") {
		out["created_at"] = item.CreatedAt
	}
	if fields.Has("updated_at") {
		out["updated_at"] = item.UpdatedAt
	}
	translation := selectSectionTranslation(translations, lang)
	if fields.Has("title") {
		out["title"] = translation.Title
	}
	if fields.Has("description") {
		out["description"] = translation.Description
	}
	if fields.Has("translations") {
		out["translations"] = mapSectionTranslationResponse(translations)
	}
	return out
}

func selectModuleTranslation(translations []domain.ModuleI18n, lang string) domain.ModuleI18n {
	if lang != "" {
		for _, translation := range translations {
			if translation.Language == lang {
				return translation
			}
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if translation.Title != "" || translation.Description != "" {
			return translation
		}
	}
	return domain.ModuleI18n{}
}

func selectSectionTranslation(translations []domain.SectionI18n, lang string) domain.SectionI18n {
	if lang != "" {
		for _, translation := range translations {
			if translation.Language == lang {
				return translation
			}
		}
	}
	for _, translation := range translations {
		if translation.Title != "" || translation.Description != "" {
			return translation
		}
	}
	return domain.SectionI18n{}
}

func mapModuleTranslationResponse(translations []domain.ModuleI18n) []map[string]any {
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"module_id":   translation.ModuleID,
			"i18n_id":     translation.I18nID,
			"lang":        translation.Language,
			"title":       translation.Title,
			"description": translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func mapSectionTranslationResponse(translations []domain.SectionI18n) []map[string]any {
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"section_id":  translation.SectionID,
			"i18n_id":     translation.I18nID,
			"lang":        translation.Language,
			"title":       translation.Title,
			"description": translation.Description,
		})
	}
	return result
}
